run_NVE_MolecularDynamics: run NVE ensemble molecular dynamics simulation on atomic structures using VelocityVerlet integrator
get_thermo_from_log: read thermo log files and extract simulation time and total energy arrays
load_MD22_TM23_data: load MD22 or TM23 dataset molecules with their target temperatures from XYZ files
relax_structure_LBFGS: relax atomic structures to local minima using LBFGS optimizer before running MD
write_NVE_results: write NVE molecular dynamics thermo log results and validate time and energy arrays
